title: On Attracting a crowd from the next street
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：attract　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attract 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the tailor ① attracted a crowd from the next street in public, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② attracts a crowd from the next street in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ attract a crowd from the next street at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ attracted a crowd from the next street before — a line in the order for November 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Attracting a crowd from the next street in public, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ attract the bees from three hives in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Attract the bees from three hives at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ attracts the bees from three hives in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ attracted a crowd from the next street again when nobody else would.

⑩ To attract a crowd from the next street, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody attracts a crowd from the next street in silence again and somebody must attract a crowd from the next street in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 吸引（一般过去式 attracted a crowd from the next street：1955 年裁缝头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 吸引（一般现在 attracts a crowd from the next street：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 吸引（不定式 to attract a crowd from the next street：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 吸引（过去完成时 had attracted a crowd from the next street：1949 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 吸引（动名词 attracting a crowd from the next street 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 招来（attract the bees from three hives：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去招来三个蜂箱的蜜蜂）
G. v. 招来（attract the bees from three hives：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 吸引（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 attracts the bees from three hives，而母亲又一次 attracted a crowd from the next street）

items.q: attracted a crowd from the next street

answers.why: attract 意为“吸引”，1955 年裁缝当着众人面吸引邻街聚来的一群人，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 attracted。
attract 意为“吸引”，自那以后裁缝一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 attracts。
attract 意为“吸引”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯吸引邻街聚来的一群人”，此处为不定式 to attract a crowd from the next street。
attract 意为“吸引”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人吸引过，故用过去完成时 had attracted。
attract 意为“吸引”，裁缝说“吸引邻街聚来的一群人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 attracting a crowd from the next street 作主语。
attract 意为“招来”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去招来三个蜂箱的蜜蜂”，should ever 之后用原形 attract the bees from three hives。
attract 意为“招来”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻招来三个蜂箱的蜜蜂（attract the bees from three hives at once），以后再也不要提起。
attract 意为“吸引”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例招来三个蜂箱的蜜蜂，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 attracts。
attract 意为“吸引”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面吸引邻街聚来的一群人，用一般过去式 attracted 叙述。
attract 意为“吸引”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要吸引邻街聚来的一群人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，裁缝当着众人面吸引邻街聚来的一群人；裁缝铺里每一个顾客都说这是头一回。（attracted a crowd from the next street）
多年以后，裁缝仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（attracts a crowd from the next street）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯吸引邻街聚来的一群人这件事本身。（to attract a crowd from the next street）
早在 1949 年就有人吸引邻街聚来的一群人，十一月那天订单簿上的一行字就是证据。（had attracted a crowd from the next street）
裁缝说过，当着众人面吸引邻街聚来的一群人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（attracting a crowd from the next street 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻招来三个蜂箱的蜜蜂，以后再也不要提起。（attract the bees from three hives，祈使句）
answers: In 1955 the tailor attracted a crowd from the next street in public, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the tailor still attracts a crowd from the next street in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to attract a crowd from the next street at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had attracted a crowd from the next street long before 1962, and the line in the order for November proves it.
Attracting a crowd from the next street in public, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Attract the bees from three hives at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 attract 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the tailor attracted a crowd from the next street in public, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor attracts a crowd from the next street in silence whenever the shop asks.
Attracting a crowd from the next street in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever attract the bees from three hives in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop attracts the bees from three hives in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother attracted a crowd from the next street again, and the shop remembered that half.
